svg.title: IBKR Trading Bot v3.0.13 WallStreetBets-style infographic
svg.desc: High-fidelity vector conversion of the supplied poster. Every visible element is represented by vector geometry; no raster image is embedded.
svg.metadata: Vectorized from a 1024 by 1536 source PNG with a 96-color adaptive palette. Text is outlined as geometry and is not editable as live text.
